request.query: In an ordered additive commutative monoid sum over finset bounded above by cardinality nsmul bound

items.name: Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.sum f ≤ s.card • n

items.name: Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [AddLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → s.card • n ≤ s.sum f

items.name: Multiset.sum_le_card_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [AddLeftMono α] (s : Multiset α) (n : α),
  (∀ (x : α), x ∈ s → x ≤ n) → s.sum ≤ s.card • n

items.name: Finset.card_nsmul_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : AddMonoid α] {s : Finset α} {n : ℕ}, (n • s).card ≤ s.card ^ n

items.name: List.sum_le_card_nsmul
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddMonoid M] [inst_1 : Preorder M] [AddRightMono M] [AddLeftMono M] (l : List M) (n : M),
  (∀ (x : M), x ∈ l → x ≤ n) → l.sum ≤ l.length • n
